notes: v2.9.33: PUMA watermelon is redefined around observable bottom-area concentrated-capital footprints rather than only later long-MA reclaim confirmation. The model now scores abnormal relative volume, high-volume absorption patterns (large bearish bars, long upper wicks, or unusually large volume with muted price response), direct interaction with EMA112/224, and interaction/reclaim of the visible Ichimoku cloud. A bottom-area footprint touching these structural levels can mark the intervention zone before the rebound fully matures; later long-MA reclaim, settling and reversal still strengthen confirmation. The analysis panel now exposes a separate large-money footprint score and reason. This is a chart-based proxy for concentrated capital activity, not identification of any specific market participant. Arrow, Bowl-3, accumulation, zoom and live-order rules remain unchanged.
